result: One live persistence generation per 900-tick autosave, committed as a real 225 SessionKindCheckpoint inside a 278 .sdasave envelope with SHA-256 SDA-CJSON-1. The generation carries the session identity, active 109 profile, 276 daily/XP checkpoint, 277 challenge checkpoint, 268/269 company and the read-only 209/KPI snapshot; simulated time is reported separately from commit time. Export produces the file and checksum; import requires the exact preview checksum and an explicit confirmation before owners are replaced, with rollback on any staging or storage refusal. Reload starts PAUSED_AUTO, names the previous open segments INCOMPLETE and reports offlineIncome 0 / offlineXp 0. Company is rebuilt by replay in the real 268 ledger and 269 journal; a second import has XP delta 0, daily-reward delta 0 and the same company revenue. Native Save/Load buttons live in the shell with focus, Tab, Escape and zero global listeners.
limitations: The full 206 world snapshot and physical world rehydration are not part of this PBI. KPI 209 is preserved and verified as a read-only slot but the live 209 ledger is not rehydrated because owner 266 exposes no restore. The durable row uses localStorage for the tab; the IndexedDB writer-lock adapter remains the 127/234 contract. Shutdown does not force a final generation. Browser evidence is headless Chrome 157/WEBGL2, not a human playtest or FPS/GPU measurement. Local Node is 24.19.0.
